title: Game Dev Dynasty, a new tycoon where you can design game covers and compete in a living market
author: BootPhaseGames
selftext:
I'm making [Game Dev Dynasty](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5090830/Game_Dev_Dynasty), a game development tycoon inspired by Game Dev Tycoon and Crusader Kings 3. Some of the distinctive features are:

* When developing a game, there's no hidden recipe. Instead, quality and market success are independent. So you can make a niche indie 10 that doesn't sell much, or a blockbuster best-selling multiplayer FPS that gets a 6 in reviews.
* The market simulation is very deep and dynamic. Each platform has a share of the market, there are 3 different audiences with different tastes and behaviors (Casual, Mainstream and Hardcore), there are 4 world regions, and up to 100 concurrent competitors that all make games and compete with each other.
* You can design your own game covers, by selecting the base art, the title style and the position and size.
* You can make franchises, sequels, ports, spin-offs, remasters and remakes. Each one has its own particularities.
* License a game engine or invest in a custom engine by researching a tech tree.
* The goal of the game is to become the most prestigious studio in the world. Prestige is a score you can earn or lose depending on how you do.
* There are many CK3-like events, with skill challenges. Characters have good and bad traits.
* You can upgrade your PC hardware: motherboard, RAM, CPU and disk.

The main use of AI is creating the games base cover art images at a scale that allows me to have specific covers for each genre, topic and gaming generation while avoiding repetition. What's cool is the algorithm that dynamically adds the player-selected game title according to the selected style, making it look like a real cover. Like WordArt in the old days!

Let me know what you would like to see in a new game dev simulator!
